title: Decorative · final CTA banner
description: Bottom-of-page CTA section adapted from Section 16 standalone. Dark card surface, mono eyebrow, large closing H2, three-copy rhythm, and canonical ServiceWand primary/secondary CTA pair. Intended as the final conversion section above the footer.

source.adapted_from: Section 16 · Get Started — static lab-ui block, no React runtime
source.decision: Bottom CTA enters lab-ui as a durable block; uses existing CTA button contracts and page-level accent tokens.
